Australia v England. Coverage of the second ODI in the three-match series, which takes place at Adelaide Oval. These two sides last faced each other in this format in September 2024 when Australia travelled to England for a five-match contest. They won the first two games by seven wickets and 68 runs respectively before England fought back with a 46-run victory and a 186-run win to take the series to a decider. Australia finally came out on top with a comfortable 49-run victory in the fifth and final contest in Bristol.

A look back at the best goals from the 2005/06 season. Thierry Henry became the first player in the league's history to win the Golden Boot four times, top-scoring with 27 goals.
A look back at the best goals from the 2006/07 season. Chelsea's Didier Drogba topped the scoring charts with 20 goals, ahead of Benni McCarthy (18) and Cristiano Ronaldo.
A look back at the best goals from the 2007/08 season. Cristiano Ronaldo topped the scoring charts with a remarkable 31 goals, ahead of Fernando Torres and Emmanuel Adebayor on 24.
A look back at the best goals from the 2008/09 season. Chelsea striker Nicolas Anelka secured the Golden Boot with 19 goals, beating Cristiano Ronaldo to the prize.
We revisit the best goals from the 2009/2010 season. In his most prolific season for Chelsea, Didier Drogba secured the Golden Boot with 29 goals, three ahead of Wayne Rooney.
A look back at the best goals from the 2010/2011 season. Dimitar Berbatov and Carlos Tevez shared the Golden Boot with 20 goals, ahead of Robin van Persie who finished with 18.
A look back at the best goals from the 2011/12 season. With 30 goals, Robin van Persie won the Golden Boot in his final season for Arsenal, finishing three ahead of Wayne Rooney.
A look back at the top strikes from the 2012/13 season. Robin van Persie finished top of the charts with 26 goals, three ahead of Luis Suarez and five in front of Gareth Bale.
A look back at the top goals from the 2013/14 season. Luis Suarez - in his final season at Anfield - finished top scorer with 31 goals, 10 ahead of team-mate Daniel Sturridge.
A look back at the most memorable goals from the 2014/15 season. Sergio Aguero won the Golden Boot with 26 goals, five ahead of Harry Kane and six in front of Diego Costa.
A look back at the top goals from the 2015/16 season. Harry Kane beat Sergio Aguero and Jamie Vardy to the Golden Boot, while Watford's Odion Ighalo and Troy Deeney also impressed.
A look back at the best goals from the 2016/17 season. Harry Kane won the Golden Boot for the second successive season with 29 goals, scoring seven goals in Spurs' last two games.
A look back at the best goals from the 2017/18 season. Liverpool's Mohamed Salah held off Harry Kane to clinch the Golden Boot, as both players reached 30 goals.

Australia v England. Coverage of the third ODI in the three-match series, which takes place at Ninja Stadium in Hobart, Tasmania. The hosts have won the last three ODI series against their oldest rivals, including a 3-2 victory in England in September 2024.
